# 1 Visualising Time-series Data

transfer to long data first



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer <- ts_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
             y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](hands-onEx19_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



use facet_wrap() to wrap cause countries have different volume

can use fig-height: 20 for adjust quator plot size



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = ts_longer, 
       aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
           y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Country,
             ncol = 3,
             scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](hands-onEx19_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



123



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_tsibble <- ts_data %>%
  mutate(Month = yearmonth(`Month-Year`)) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = `Month`)

tsibble_longer <- ts_tsibble %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam" |
         Country == "Italy") %>% 
  gg_subseries(Arrivals)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](hands-onEx19_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



ACF\



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(`Country` == "Vietnam") %>%
  ACF(Arrivals) %>% 
  autoplot()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](hands-onEx19_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



forecasting \



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_ts <- tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>% 
  mutate(Type = if_else(
    `Month-Year` >= "2019-01-01", 
    "Hold-out", "Training"))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_train <- vietnam_ts %>%
  filter(`Month-Year` < "2019-01-01")
```
:::
